title: Scale a streaming load-harness for SSE/WebSocket chat completions with regression detection
creator: Priya Shah
description: Build a scalable, repeatable load-testing harness that can exercise streaming chat/completions (SSE and WebSocket) at production-like scale to measure tokens/sec, p95/p99 latencies, connection churn behavior, and detect regressions. The harness must support: configurable traffic profiles (message lengths, concurrency, connect/disconnect patterns), KV/prefix cache warmup, model variants and fallback routing, realistic burst patterns, and exportable metrics for Grafana/Prometheus. Deliverables include a reusable runner, CI job that gates PRs on performance regressions, dashboard panels, and a regression-detection alerting rule. Primary consumers: runtime team and benchmarking/solutions engineers.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can sustain 200k concurrent streaming connections (SSE + WS mix) in a multi-region test cluster and report tokens/sec
p95 and p99 latency histograms recorded per-route and per-model with 1-minute and 5-minute aggregations
Automated regression detection: baseline comparison for tokens/sec and p95 with configurable thresholds (relative and absolute) and PR gating integration
CI job runs a smoke and an extended run (30m) and uploads summarized artifacts to the performance bucket
Grafana dashboard panels for tokens/sec, active connections, connect errors, p95/p99, and KV cache hit rate; links included in ticket
Documentation and runbook for running the harness on Dedicated and Private clusters with sample configs
tasks: Design traffic profile schema (message templates, lengths, inter-token timing)
Implement SSE client library with reconnect backoff and jitter
Implement WebSocket client with per-message streaming consumption and latency tagging
Add KV/prefix cache warmup hooks to reproduce realistic cache-hit distributions
Integrate metrics exporter (Prometheus) and create Grafana dashboards
Create regression-detector that compares current run to baseline and emits pass/fail
Add CI pipeline step that runs harness against a staging cluster and posts results to PRs
Run a 200k connection scale test and collect artifacts; iterate on bottlenecks
